clauses.quote: The District and the Association shall apply for a waiver of the instructional minutes requirement of Education Code Section 46201 if it becomes necessary to declare more than two (2) modified days in any school year under the circumstances stated below:

the Superintendent shall declare a modified day or days for students in all non-air-conditioned facilities, or facilities where the air-conditioning has been non-functional for one consecutive 24-hour period after appropriate parent notices have been sent home.
the starting time for afternoon kindergarten shall be adjusted to permit a uniform release time in those schools where facilities permit.
clauses.subject_text: the starting time for afternoon kindergarten

clauses.quote: The District shall make reasonable efforts to keep all school grounds and facilities free of unwanted rodents, pests, and insects such as ants, roaches, and fleas.
